provenance.derivation: The reviewed short stream was produced from the fixed payload with a standards-conforming implementation; tests consume but do not regenerate it. The two boundary streams are complete RFC 1950/1951 zlib streams produced once with zlib 1.3.2.1 at level 9 from respectively 16 MiB and 16 MiB plus one all-zero bytes. Their immutable input bytes, expected size, and the accepted boundary SHA-256 are recorded here.
